 Dengue: Death toll reaches 384 as seven more die 
 Another 2,249 patients were hospitalised in 24 hours, taking this year’s total cases to 123,948. 
 TBS Report 
 25 October, 2026, 05:35 pm 
 Last modified: 25 October, 2026, 05:34 pm 
 Illustration: TBS "> 
 Illustration: TBS 
 Seven more people have died of dengue, taking this year's death toll to 384, while 2,249 new patients were admitted to hospitals across the country in the 24 hours until 8am today (25 October). 
 According to the daily update from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), two patients each died in Dhaka North City Corporation and Mymensingh Division, while one each died in Dhaka South City Corporation, Khulna Division and Rajshahi Division.
 September recorded the highest monthly death toll so far this year, with 148 fatalities.
 Keep updated, follow The Business Standard's Google news channel
 From January to May, dengue claimed five lives in total, followed by 13 deaths in June, 36 in July and 43 in August.
 Meanwhile, 2,268 patients were discharged from hospitals during the same 24-hour period, taking the total number of recoveries this year to 117,400.
 The cumulative number of dengue cases reported across the country has reached 123,948, according to DGHS data.
